tool.name: Aembit IAM for Agentic AI
tool.description: Policy-based, just-in-time access for AI agents via an MCP Authorization Server and MCP Identity Gateway with credential injection.
tool.pricing: Starter free (3 agents); Teams $20/agent/month (10 to 500 agents); Enterprise custom.
tool.practitionerNote: Good fit for securing agent-to-MCP traffic without handing agents secrets; note the gateway is a self-run Linux VM and free-tier log retention is 24 hours.

dataResidency.detail: Data residency for the managed authorization service is not stated in the GA post or pricing page.

deployment.detail: Managed MCP Authorization Server plus a self-hosted Linux VM MCP Identity Gateway; containerized options on roadmap.

auditLogging.detail: Structured audit logs that integrate with SIEM; retention 24h (Starter), 7 days (Teams), custom (Enterprise).

soc2.detail: Aembit states SOC 2 Type II certification.

iso27001.detail: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified (Sensiba LLP, ANAB-accredited), announced March 2025.

iso42001.detail: No ISO/IEC 42001 certification found on Aembit's pages reviewed.

euAiAct.detail: Identity and access-control tooling for agents, not itself an AI system placed on the market; AI Act obligations rest with the provider/deployer of the governed agents.

licenseRisk.detail: Proprietary Aembit service; secretless access depends on Aembit's identity broker.
